guest_name.description: The guest's confirmed full name for the reservation.

reservation_date.description: The confirmed reservation date in YYYY-MM-DD format, resolved using the Asia/Dubai timezone.

reservation_time.description: The confirmed reservation time in 24-hour HH:mm format using the Asia/Dubai timezone.

party_size.description: The confirmed total number of guests. Must be a whole number between 1 and 8.

occasion.description: The special occasion. Use an empty string when there is no occasion.

dietary_requirements.description: All confirmed allergies or dietary requirements. Use an empty string when there are none.

special_requests.description: Any other confirmed guest request. Use an empty string when there are no special requests.
